meaning.en: To speak rudely or insolently.
meaning.zh: 说话粗鲁无礼，不客气。

examples.zh: 他在会上出言不逊，顶撞了领导。
examples.en: He spoke insolently at the meeting and talked back to his boss.

examples.zh: 球员因对裁判出言不逊被罚下场。
examples.en: The player was sent off for verbally abusing the referee.

synonyms: 狗嘴里吐不出象牙——说不出好话

meaning.en: So cruel or tragic that nothing in the world compares.
meaning.zh: 世上再没有比这更惨的了。形容极其悲惨或残酷。

examples.zh: 侵略者犯下了惨绝人寰的罪行。
examples.en: The invaders committed unspeakable atrocities.

examples.zh: 这是一场惨绝人寰的灾难。
examples.en: It was a catastrophe of unimaginable horror.

usage.zh: 多作定语，修饰罪行、屠杀等。

meaning.en: To vanish completely; come to nothing.
meaning.zh: 变得什么都没有了。指全部丧失或完全落空。

examples.zh: 一场大火，多年的积蓄化为乌有。
examples.en: In one fire, years of savings went up in smoke.

examples.zh: 股市暴跌让他的财富瞬间化为乌有。
examples.en: The market crash wiped out his fortune overnight.

origin.source: 苏轼《章质夫送酒六壶书至而酒不达戏作小诗问之》

story.en: Su Shi joked that six jars of wine promised by a friend never arrived and had 'turned into Mr Nonexistent' — 乌有先生, a fictional character from Sima Xiangru's 'Zixu Rhapsody'.
story.zh: 苏轼诗：“岂意青州六从事，化为乌有一先生。”

meaning.en: To stir up trouble and incite others.
meaning.zh: 比喻煽动别人闹事或制造事端。

examples.zh: 有人在网上煽风点火，故意制造对立。
examples.en: Someone online is fanning the flames and deliberately stirring up division.

examples.zh: 他们吵架，你就别在旁边煽风点火了。
examples.en: They're arguing — don't stand there stirring things up.

meaning.en: To work hard and get no thanks or results for it.
meaning.zh: 花了很大力气，结果却得不到好处或别人的好评。

examples.zh: 当中间人往往吃力不讨好。
examples.en: Being the go-between is often a thankless task.

examples.zh: 这种吃力不讨好的事，没人愿意干。
examples.en: Nobody wants to do a thankless job like that.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 吃力不讨好的事/活儿.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“吃力不讨好的事”。

synonyms: 羊肉没吃着，惹了一身膻

meaning.en: So moving that it stirs one to the depths.
meaning.zh: 使肝肠回旋，使心气激荡。形容文章、乐曲等十分婉转动人。

examples.zh: 这首歌旋律优美，荡气回肠。
examples.en: The song's melody is beautiful and deeply moving.

examples.zh: 影片讲述了一个荡气回肠的爱情故事。
examples.en: The film tells a soul-stirring love story.

story.en: Cao Pi described singing that 'moves the heart and pleases the ear, stirs the breath and turns the bowels'.
story.zh: 曹丕《大墙上蒿行》：“女娥长歌，声协宫商，感心动耳，荡气回肠。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; of music, writing, stories.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容乐曲、文章、故事。

meaning.en: With complete sincerity.
meaning.zh: 形容心意真诚。

equivalents: from the bottom of one's heart

examples.zh: 我是诚心诚意来向你道歉的。
examples.en: I've come to apologise to you in all sincerity.

examples.zh: 他诚心诚意地帮助每一位新同事。
examples.en: He wholeheartedly helps every new colleague.

meaning.en: To overcorrect a mistake and go too far the other way.
meaning.zh: 纠正偏差而超过了应有的限度。

equivalents: go too far the other way

examples.zh: 整顿要适度，不要矫枉过正。
examples.en: The clean-up should be measured — don't overcorrect.

examples.zh: 为了减肥完全不吃饭，这是矫枉过正。
examples.en: Going without food altogether to lose weight is going too far the other way.

story.en: The Han History says Han policy, in correcting the Qin's mistakes, 'can be said to have straightened the crooked beyond straight'.
story.zh: 《汉书·诸侯王表》：“可谓矫枉过其正矣。”

usage.en: Predicate; often 不要/不能矫枉过正.

meaning.en: Majestic and full of grandeur.
meaning.zh: 形容气势盛大，雄伟壮观。

examples.zh: 这幅山水画大气磅礴。
examples.en: This landscape painting is majestic.

examples.zh: 开幕式的表演大气磅礴，令人震撼。
examples.en: The opening ceremony was grand and awe-inspiring.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; of art, writing, scenery, performances.

meaning.en: To be famous for a while.
meaning.zh: 名声在一个时期内传扬得很广。

equivalents: all the rage at the time

examples.zh: 这位作家曾经名噪一时，如今却很少有人提起。
examples.en: The writer was famous in his day, but few mention him now.

examples.zh: 那款游戏名噪一时，后来渐渐没人玩了。
examples.en: That game was all the rage for a while, then gradually faded.

meaning.en: Weak and unconvincing; lacking force.
meaning.zh: 形容文章、言辞等缺乏说服力或感染力；也指面色苍白、身体虚弱。

examples.zh: 在事实面前，他的辩解显得苍白无力。
examples.en: In the face of the facts his excuses sounded feeble.

examples.zh: 这篇文章语言苍白无力，缺乏感染力。
examples.en: The writing in this essay is lifeless and fails to move the reader.

usage.en: Predicate; often 显得苍白无力.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“显得苍白无力”。

meaning.en: To be close to and love one another.
meaning.zh: 形容彼此关系密切，感情深厚。

examples.zh: 祝你们相亲相爱，白头偕老。
examples.en: May you love each other dearly and grow old together.

examples.zh: 我们是相亲相爱的一家人。
examples.en: We're a close and loving family.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also used as a wedding wish.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，也用作婚礼祝福。

meaning.en: Clear-headed and refreshed.
meaning.zh: 神志清爽，心情舒畅。

examples.zh: 睡了个好觉，早上起来神清气爽。
examples.en: After a good night's sleep I woke up feeling refreshed.

examples.zh: 爬到山顶，呼吸着新鲜空气，让人神清气爽。
examples.en: Breathing the fresh air at the summit leaves you clear-headed and invigorated.

meaning.en: Flustered and in a hurry.
meaning.zh: 形容做事急忙，不沉着。

examples.zh: 他慌慌张张地跑进教室，连书包都忘了带。
examples.en: He rushed into the classroom in a fluster and even forgot his schoolbag.

examples.zh: 别慌慌张张的，慢慢说。
examples.en: Don't get so flustered — tell me slowly.

meaning.en: Flowers of brilliant, varied colours.
meaning.zh: 形容各种颜色的花朵娇艳美丽。

examples.zh: 春天的公园里姹紫嫣红，游人如织。
examples.en: In spring the park is a riot of colour, crowded with visitors.

examples.zh: 花展上姹紫嫣红的郁金香吸引了很多人。
examples.en: The tulips in every colour drew big crowds at the flower show.

story.en: Du Liniang, seeing the spring garden, sings that flowers of every bright hue are blooming all around.
story.zh: 《牡丹亭》：“原来姹紫嫣红开遍，似这般都付与断井颓垣。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often of spring flowers.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多写春花。

synonyms: 乱花渐欲迷人眼，浅草才能没马蹄

meaning.en: To speak hesitantly, as if hiding something.
meaning.zh: 想说又不敢说或说话含混。

examples.zh: 他吞吞吐吐了半天，才说出实情。
examples.en: He hemmed and hawed for ages before telling the truth.

examples.zh: 有话直说，别吞吞吐吐的。
examples.en: Spit it out — stop beating about the bush.

natural: as if facing a mighty foe

meaning.en: To be extremely tense and on guard, as if facing a powerful enemy.
meaning.zh: 好像面临强大的敌人。形容戒备森严或把局势看得非常严重。

equivalents: as tense as if facing a mighty foe

examples.zh: 考试前，全班同学如临大敌。
examples.en: Before the exam the whole class was as tense as if facing an enemy.

examples.zh: 峰会期间，警方如临大敌，严密布控。
examples.en: During the summit the police were on high alert with tight security.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，有时带讽刺意味。

meaning.en: Many neglected things are waiting to be restored.
meaning.zh: 许多被废置的事情等待兴办。

equivalents: a country in need of reconstruction

examples.zh: 战后初期，百废待兴。
examples.en: In the early post-war years, everything needed rebuilding.

examples.zh: 新校长上任时，学校百废待兴。
examples.en: When the new head took over, the school had to be rebuilt from the ground up.

usage.en: Predicate; often of post-war or post-disaster periods.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指战后或灾后。

meaning.en: To talk nonsense.
meaning.zh: 没有根据地瞎说。

examples.zh: 他喝醉了，开始胡言乱语。
examples.en: He got drunk and started talking nonsense.

examples.zh: 别听他胡言乱语，根本没有这回事。
examples.en: Don't listen to his rubbish — nothing of the sort happened.

meaning.en: So moving that it brings people to tears.
meaning.zh: 使人感动得流泪。

examples.zh: 这部电影的结尾催人泪下。
examples.en: The ending of the film moves you to tears.

examples.zh: 她讲述了一个催人泪下的真实故事。
examples.en: She told a heart-rending true story.

meaning.en: One's own selfish interests.
meaning.zh: 个人的私利。

examples.zh: 官员绝不能为了一己之私损害公众利益。
examples.en: Officials must never harm the public interest for personal gain.

examples.zh: 他出于一己之私，隐瞒了事实。
examples.en: He concealed the truth for his own selfish ends.

usage.en: Object; usually 为了/出于一己之私.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“为了一己之私”。

meaning.en: Casual and careless in manner; not fussed about details.
meaning.zh: 形容随随便便、满不在乎的样子。

examples.zh: 她性格大大咧咧，从不计较小事。
examples.en: She's happy-go-lucky and never fusses over little things.

examples.zh: 他大大咧咧的，经常丢三落四。
examples.en: He's so laid-back that he's always losing things.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can be affectionate or mildly critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，可褒可贬。

meaning.en: Seamless and natural, as if made by nature.
meaning.zh: 形容诗文、艺术品等结构严密自然，毫无雕琢痕迹；也形容人的才德完美自然。

examples.zh: 这首诗浑然天成，没有雕琢的痕迹。
examples.en: This poem is seamless, with no trace of artifice.

examples.zh: 建筑与山水浑然天成，融为一体。
examples.en: The buildings blend seamlessly into the landscape.
